_info: Nachgepflegte Felder für die 42 Altprojekte (08.10.2026). import.mjs übernimmt sie ins Frontmatter; der Beitragstext bleibt unverändert. Team nur, wo Namen im Beitrag stehen. Nach dem Livegang wird im CMS gepflegt. cover: aus den Bildern des Beitrags ausgewählt (Fotos statt Diagramme). links: automatisch aus dem Text, außer wo hier angegeben.

a-data-driven-approach-to-wavetable-synt.summary: A GAN generates single-cycle wavetables from your own sounds and aligns them automatically, so they can be morphed smoothly in a dedicated oscillator framework.

ants.summary: Interactive path-following simulation: draw a path and watch ants with individual speed and steering forces follow it.

arduino-guitar-amp.summary: A portable, battery-powered digital guitar amp built around an Arduino Uno, with programmable effects, mounted into an old amp housing.

auction-system-for-space-game.summary: Ein Auktionssystem für das browserbasierte Space Game, über das Spielerinnen und Spieler Waren handeln.

audio-sampler-plugin-with-juce.summary: CTAG Drum Sampler: a VST plugin built with JUCE that plays drum samples in five modes – a hands-on way to learn the framework.

beagleboom.summary: A Eurorack sampler based on the BeagleBone that searches, downloads and plays sounds from freesound.org, controlled by MIDI or CV/gate.

browser-game-controller-backend.summary: A backend that turns smartphones into game controllers, using their touchscreen, accelerometer and gyroscope as input for browser games.

compressor-plugin-with-juce.summary: A good-sounding VST3/AU dynamic range compressor with a minimal interface, built with JUCE to dig into the DSP behind compression.

ctag-strampler-a-eurorack-sample-streami.summary: Half streamer, half sampler: an open-source Eurorack module that streams large audio files from SD card and connects to freesound.org.

ctag-tbd-eurorack-open-source.summary: An open-source Eurorack sound module based on the ESP32 with an easy-to-extend plugin architecture – a platform to learn, build and practise.

flock.summary: Interactive flocking simulation: bees steer by separation, alignment and cohesion and fly towards flowers you place.

generative-visualisierung-von-musik-mitt.summary: Wie lässt sich Musik mit KI visualisieren? Neben Musikmerkmalen fließen auch annotierte Emotionen der Hörenden in die generierten Bilder ein.

implementation-and-performance-analysis-.summary: Implementation of the Precision Time Protocol (IEEE 1588) on a Linux system-on-chip and analysis of the synchronisation accuracy it reaches.

implementation-of-a-distributed-ai-drive.summary: A distributed sample manager that tags, clusters and recommends drum sounds with machine learning – for producers drowning in sample libraries.

ki-for-space-game.summary: Grundlagen für eine erweiterbare künstliche Intelligenz im Space Game: Ressourcenschiffe und Piraten, die sich wie Mitspieler verhalten.

libdsp-x15.summary: A library for the C66x DSPs on the BeagleBoard-X15 with FFT, filters and real-time examples, focused on audio applications.

licht-mal-maschine-limama.summary: Ein fahrender Roboter, der beliebige Grafiken vom PC oder Smartphone Spalte für Spalte in Langzeitbelichtungen malt.

light-table.summary: Ein Tisch, dessen Platte von unten mit RGB-LEDs leuchtet und zugleich per Infrarotsensoren als „Touchscreen“ funktioniert – modular aufgebaut.

linux-based-low-latency-multichannel-aud.summary: CTAG face2|4: a low-latency multichannel audio card for the BeagleBone with up to 8 channels at 96 kHz and an open-source Linux driver.

litesolder.summary: An extension for the LitePlacer pick-and-place machine that dispenses solder paste precisely onto rectangular and circular PCB pads.

media-ip-streaming-on-embedded-systems.summary: Real-time audio streaming over Ethernet for BeagleBone AI and Black, implementing parts of the AVB protocol – a Google Summer of Code 2020 project.

midi-interface-for-dpm-48-drum-machine.summary: A MIDI interface for the 1984 Sakata DPM-48 drum machine, so its EPROM drum sounds can be played from any MIDI device – plus extended sound banks.

midifox-is-eurorack-module.summary: A small Eurorack module that turns MIDI over USB into note CV, velocity and gate – with schematics, code and KiCad files.

mimabox.summary: Eine akkubetriebene Lautsprecherbox mit Verstärker, Subwoofer und Batteriemonitor – für die Party am Strand.

modularer-web-synthesizer.summary: Ein modularer Synthesizer im Browser auf Basis der Web Audio API, der externe Geräte über einen Node.js-Server per WebSocket einbindet.

multiplayer-webracer.summary: A browser racing game in which every player's smartphone becomes controller and second screen – no special hardware needed.

online-multi-player-puzzle-game.summary: A puzzle that everyone solves together on a big screen, each player joining from their smartphone's browser.

procedural-generation.summary: First steps of the Space Game: the map format for solar systems and how maps are generated, stored and loaded at runtime.

ravenna-audio-ip-streaming.summary: A virtual ALSA driver for Linux that streams audio according to the AES67 audio-over-IP standard used in broadcast.

rhythmusgenerierung-mit-kunstlicher-inte.summary: Kann ein ESP32 mit wenig Ressourcen per maschinellem Lernen Schlagzeugspuren zu Nutzereingaben erzeugen? Modelle, Messungen und Grenzen.

robotic-eye.summary: A Raspberry Pi with a servo-mounted camera that detects faces with OpenCV and follows them.

sequencer-web-frontend.summary: A web interface hosted on an ESP32 that lets anyone control an embedded step sequencer from a browser over Wi-Fi.

setup-and-evaluation-of-an-media-ip-real.summary: Setting up an audio-over-IP chain on standard Ethernet hardware and measuring how close to real time it gets.

sound-synthesis-using-embedded-linux-zyn.summary: An Odroid U3 with a real-time kernel runs the ZynAddSubFX synthesizer with under 10 ms latency – packed into a Eurorack module.

sound-visualizer-mask.summary: An LED mask with about 420 RGB LEDs for live performances, showing visuals that react to MIDI and audio from Ableton Live in real time.

space-game-refactoring.summary: Mehrere getrennte Space-Game-Projekte zusammengeführt, aktualisiert und um eine KI sowie ein Ressourcensystem erweitert.

space-game-visualization-engine.summary: The 3D engine of the multiplayer Space Game: spaceships, galaxy and interaction rendered in the browser with Three.js.

synchronized-real-time-audio-streaming-o.summary: Study, implementation and evaluation of AVB for synchronised real-time audio streaming over Ethernet on BeagleBoard hardware and Linux.

teensy-audio-library-extension-for-ctag-.summary: Connects a Teensy 3.6 to the CTAG face2|4 sound card and extends the Teensy audio library, including a Freeverb reverb.

the-house-haus.summary: A painted house whose twelve windows are touch sensors in conductive paint: touching them starts loops in Ableton Live, so visitors build an electronic track together.

troll8.summary: An Arduino-based micro synth and MIDI controller as an open-source development platform.

usb-audio-class-2-i2s-bridge.summary: Eine USB-Audio-Class-2-Bridge, die einen PC direkt mit dem Codec der Soundkarte face2|4 verbindet.
